svg.title: Two threads run count++ at once and one increment is lost
svg.desc: Time runs left to right in six steps. Thread A reads 41, thread B reads 41, both add 1 in their own registers, A writes 42, then B writes 42 over it. Two increments ran and count went from 41 to 42.
svg.text: count++ is read, add, write: two threads, count starts at 41
two increments ran, count went up by one
